in_marathi.name: Bhatu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhatu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhatu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Bhagat, meaning 'devotee' or 'servant of God'. The name Bhatu is often used to refer to the Hindu god Ganesha, who is considered the lord of wealth and the remover of obstacles. This name is believed to bring prosperity and abundance to those who bear it.
